content: This paper presents a new method for simultaneously selecting important longitudinal features and classifying categorical outcomes in healthcare data, using logistic loss and functional principal components to improve computational efficiency. The method, validated through simulations and real-world chronic disease data, addresses high-dimensional scenarios where the number of features exceeds the number of patients.
